High inflation combined with high unemployment and stagnant demand ( उच्च मुद्रास्फीति के साथ - साथ उच्च बेरोजगारी और स्थिर मांग )
Low inflation and low unemployment ( कम मुद्रास्फीति और कम बेरोजगारी )
Deflation and rapid industrialization ( अपस्फीति और तीव्र औद्योगीकरण )
solution: Stagflation is a portmanteau of "stagnation" and "inflation." Additional Info (a) High inflation and high growth is typical of a standard economic expansion or "boom." (b) Stagflation presents a dilemma for central banks, as standard policies to lower inflation (like raising interest rates) can further suppress growth and worsen unemployment. (c) Low inflation and low unemployment is ideal and sometimes called a "Goldilocks economy." (d) Deflation is a general decline in prices, typically occurring during severe economic depressions. Trivalent impurity (e.g., Boron, Indium) ( त्रिसंयोजक (Trivalent) अशुद्धता ( जैसे , बोरोन , इंडियम ))

Hexavalent impurity (e.g., Sulfur) ( हेक्सावैलेंट अशुद्धता ( जैसे , सल्फर ))

q: 100. In organic chemistry, the (Bimolecular Nucleophilic Substitution) reaction mechanism proceeds via a single transition state.
